title: Add browser smoke suite for port forwards users audit and settings
description: Cover representative CRUD/navigation/action flows for port forwards, users/activity, audit, tools, webhooks, and settings with accessibility and error assertions.
acceptanceCriteria: Each representative route loads without page/console errors and shows its localized heading/state
Create/edit/delete/confirmation flows use accessible controls and provide result feedback
Audit and settings pages do not expose secrets in visible content or browser responses
Empty/loading/error states are understandable and keyboard operable

steps.details: Write a route matrix for en/fa with headings, primary action, empty state, and one error path; run before fixes.
Create temporary records through supported APIs/fixtures and clean them after the run; do not use real data.
Correct only demonstrated integration/accessibility/error-state gaps, preserving existing API/schema contracts.
Run the matrix in both locales, inspect browser responses for secrets, and run typecheck/lint/custom tests.

technicalNotes: Route coverage is representative, not a claim of exhaustive WCAG conformance.
